question.text: When did the dedicated Social Stock Exchange (SSE) wings of NSE and BSE formally launch in India?

answer.text: January 2018, following the Union Budget 2019-20 announcement
March 2020, during the SEBI framework revamp post-COVID
September 2022, with NSE-SSE and BSE-SSE established as segments of existing exchanges

explanation.text: The Logic: The Social Stock Exchange segments at NSE (NSE-SSE) and BSE (BSE-SSE) were established as dedicated wings of the existing exchanges for fundraising by Social Enterprises, following SEBI's notification of the SSE framework via amendments to the ICDR Regulations in mid-2022. Public records identify September 2022 as the launch reference point for these SSE segments. The Trap: Option A conflates the Union Budget 2019-20 announcement of the SSE concept with the actual launch. Option B places the launch in March 2020, before the regulatory framework existed. Option D confuses later regulatory amendments with the original launch date. Note: The cited Social Impact Assessors workbook confirms that NSE and BSE have established dedicated SSE wings but does not state the specific September 2022 launch month/year in the pages reviewed. The launch-date framing above reflects publicly available SEBI/exchange announcements rather than a direct workbook citation.
